value.rationale: Temporal current noise is a natural dynamical observable not fixed by a single-time stationary current distribution. The result gives the complete Laplace covariance, a finite ballistic short-time decay slope, a sharp reversal-dependent long-time memory amplitude and disorder-induced nonzero covariance plateau. This quantifies finite-speed memory separately from Poisson reset relaxation and enables comparison with diffusive gas limits; it is not a cosmetic parameter substitution.
